stem: Multiple trays from one donor group root slowly while other donor groups of the same age in the same room perform normally. What is the strongest first investigation direction?
choices: Change the entire room environment immediately
Compare donor condition, genotype history, and source genealogy before changing a common room condition
Discard all propagation records because genotype makes comparison impossible
rationale: When underperformance follows one donor group while shared room conditions are normal for others, donor/genotype/source evidence is more discriminating than a whole-room change.
